calibration.reference: Hanuš et al. (2023), A&A 679, A56, Fig.A.2 and TableB.3
calibration.notes: 2021-11-24 stellar occultation. Existing DAMIT solution in TableB.3 has λ172°,β−5°,P7.30630h, matching selected 3934. The paper scales its silhouette to occultation chords; 131±8 km is the reported volume-equivalent size.
calibration.basis: published occultation volume-equivalent diameter of the matching DAMIT model solution
calibration.assumption: Uniform scale uses the published volume-equivalent diameter with its ±8 km uncertainty. The archived file remains unit volume; the paper identifies the same existing DAMIT spin solution. No independent re-fit of occultation chords is performed here.
